card.name: Inside women's names in biographies
card.fires_on: Partway through the surname or title of a woman, often a foreign name with a feminine ending such as -ova, -ttir or -ah, in encyclopedia-style text about notable women.

modes.label: Feminine surname endings
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of a woman's surname such as Navratilova, Kokolova or Tryggvadottir.

modes.label: Women-related titles
modes.description: Pieces of nicknames or titles that refer to women, such as La Pasionaria or Al-Mar'ah al-Jadidah.

card.writes: It favors words that start a feminine reference, such as "She" and feminine forms of "one" or "a" in several languages.
card.plain: It fires inside the names of women in biographical text and prepares the model to refer to her as "she".
